title: Cold AC/Feel Right @ Home/All the Amenities
description:
Our place is perfect for 1-2 guests who prefer privacy AND convenience to airport, d’town, Opry. King bed, 2 Roku TVs, well equipped kitchen and bath, coffee, small outdoor patio. This is truly a home away from home that’s safe (alarm/security cameras), away from downtown traffic, private and quiet with lots of Southern charm. 4 min to BNA. 15 min to Opry Mills Mall/Grand Ole Opry, 15 min to downtown. Infant/child friendly! Big trucks welcome (1 acre lot). Early check ins are frequently offered.

The space
Brick duplex on shaded 1-acre lot. Side B is owner’s office, but rarely there. (You’re in A, left side) One bedroom/one bath. Kitchen space is tight (older home w/upgraded appliances) so check photos well. One Roku TV in bedroom, one in living room. Google fiber Internet. Ask for air mattress if more than 2 guests. Closet in hallway with hangers. Office desk/makeup area, chair and charging station in front room and bedroom. No pets. Please provide advance notice if you’re bringing a service dog.

Guest access
Self check in with code provided in arrival instructions. You have access to unit A (left porch with welcome sign), front parking and side patio only. Please do not access backyard, side B, carport/porch or right side of home.

Other things to note
For basic troubleshooting of any small home issues please consult troubleshooting guide. If that doesn’t fix it or there is a major maintenance issue please let us know immediately. Do not access electrical panel.
